versions.changelog:
wechat-desktop-claw-automatic-control v1.1.0 introduces advanced automation features for robust Agent integration.

- New batch mode (`--manifest`): Process multiple contacts/images in a single run, preventing WeChat from being closed between tasks.
- New screenshot option (`--screenshot`): Save chat window as PNG for result verification without closing WeChat.
- Automatic tray/minimize recovery: WeChat will restore from the tray and foreground automatically before operations.
- Structured output: Emits `[SENT_OK]`, `[SENT_FAIL]`, and `[RESULT]` markers for precise Agent parsing.
- Guaranteed WeChat persistence: The script will never close WeChat under any circumstances.
